data.name: Super Tacky Astro Ranger - S.T.A.R.
data.detailed_description:
The coolest, swaggiest, and most handsomely mysterious Astro Ranger has arrived in your galaxy.

The Blorbs? Struggling. Their God? Kidnapped. Their hope? Resting on a tremendously well dressed hero, eager for action.

The Astro Ranger is ready to save the Blorbs in style... are you ready to face the hordes of Morgs that will attempt to keep you from your destiny?

S.T.A.R. is a fast-paced 3D Seriously Tough Action Roguelike where every fight is loud, sharp, and unapologetically cool. Step into chaotic arenas packed with dangerous enemies, push your reflexes to the limit, and embrace the coolest combat in the war between Blorbs and Morgs.

High-Pressure Combat

Engage in fast, responsive battles where every hit feels impactful, readable, and satisfying. No fluff, just pure action for the coolest, as it should be.

Weapons with Personality

Each weapon changes the way you fight. Experiment with different playstyles and find your own brand of tactical chaos.

Arena-Based Mayhem

Face waves of grizzly enemies in deadly arenas designed to test your movement, timing, and adaptability... Strategically Triggering Absolute Ruin.

Roguelite Progression: Start, Try Again, Repeat.

Every run is a new chance to go further, hit harder, and slay the whole time.

Bold and Seriously Stylish Sci-fy

Discover a new world... A wondrous planet, with beautiful scenery, intelligent(ish) life forms and about 200 years of registered history...it might be fated to be swallowed by its own sun, but whose planet isn't? This one would at least go out in style.

  

So... That's Awesome, Right?

Join us now in this Super Tacky Action Roguelike and defeat the Morgs. We need your Stylish Talents Around, Ranger! The blorbs won’t save themselves, after all.

data.short_description: Play as the tackiest hero in the galaxy in this fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Battle through chaotic arenas, master various weapons, defeat the Morg Leader, and escape in style. Be bold, be reckless. Be a true S.T.A.R.
